item_short_desc: Rothco's US Flag Trucker Cap provides breathability, adjustable features, and representation of US pride as your go-to piece of headwear.
description: Rothco's US Flag Trucker Cap provides breathability, adjustable features, and representation of US pride as your go-to piece of headwear. Featuring a cotton front panel and lightweight materials to provide all-day comfort. Built with mesh side and back panels for breathability. Trucker Cap features snap closure with 7 adjustments points for your ideal fit.
